title: Professional Certificate in Project Management Skills
description: This course aims to equip the learner with key concepts and skills in managing projects.
longDescription: Project Management, principles, importance, 3 Ps. Project Manager, Roles and Responsibilities, Tips to manage multiple projects. Environmental factors that affect Project Management. How to set Business Objectives in a Project. Project Life Cycle, phases, benefits, nature of work in various industries. Project Management Basics steps to a Foolproof Project Plan. Change Management, types, and importance. This course aims to equip the learner with key concepts and skills in managing projects.
